يستكرهون (form X)
# يَسْتَكْرِهُونَ (yastakrihūna) /jas.tak.ri.huː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
# يُسْتَكْرَهُونَ (yustakrahūna) /jus.tak.ra.huː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
